cues.en: In this video, I'm going to show you how to use Python through the Jupyter IPython notebook, which comes with the Anaconda package.
cues.zh: 這段影片要示範如何透過 Anaconda 套件裡附的 Jupyter IPython Notebook 使用 Python。

cues.en: So in this video, I'm going to show you how to install Anaconda and Jupyter Notebook.
cues.zh: 也就是示範安裝 Anaconda 與 Jupyter Notebook。

cues.en: In the next video, I'm going to show you how to use Python online without any installation.
cues.zh: 下一段影片，則會示範不用安裝就能在線上使用 Python 的方式。

cues.en: Now, if you are already a comfortable Python user and you have Python installed on your computer, you might just skip this lecture and the next lecture.
cues.zh: 如果你已經熟悉 Python，電腦也已安裝 Python，可以直接跳過這堂和下一堂。

cues.en: Or maybe watch it at twice the normal speed, just in case there's anything new.
cues.zh: 或者用兩倍速看一下，確認有沒有新資訊。

cues.en: Now, I generally recommend using Python by installing the Jupyter notebook locally on your computer.
cues.zh: 一般而言，我建議在自己的電腦上安裝 Jupyter Notebook 來使用 Python。

cues.en: The advantage is that it's a local installation.
cues.zh: 優點就是在本機安裝，

cues.en: You don't have to worry about internet access.
cues.zh: 不用擔心網路連線。

cues.en: It's free, it's cross-platform, and if you install Python with the Jupyter IPython notebook, that's going to be the easiest way for you to follow along with the course.
cues.zh: 它免費、跨平台，而透過 Jupyter IPython Notebook 安裝 Python，也是最容易跟上課程的方式。

cues.en: And that's because this is the program, and this is the environment that I have filmed this entire course in.
cues.zh: 因為整門課就是用這套程式、這個環境錄製的。

cues.en: The main disadvantage of installing Python locally on your computer is that you need to be able to install new programs.
cues.zh: 在本機安裝 Python 的主要缺點，是你必須有權限安裝新程式。

cues.en: So maybe you're using a shared computer or a computer at your university where you don't have administrator
cues.zh: 也許你使用共用電腦，或學校的電腦，沒有管理員，

cues.en: access and you're not able to install new programs in that case, then no worries, you can just see what I have to say in the next video.
cues.zh: 權限，無法安裝新程式。這也沒關係，看看下一段影片的做法即可。

cues.en: So in a moment, I'm going to switch to my browser and go to anaconda.com.
cues.zh: 稍後我要切換到瀏覽器，前往 anaconda.com。

cues.en: So here we are at the Anaconda homepage.
cues.zh: 這裡是 Anaconda 首頁。

cues.en: It's Anaconda.com.
cues.zh: 網址是 Anaconda.com。

cues.en: Now, I've actually had to rerecord this part of this video because they have changed their website quite a bit.
cues.zh: 這一段其實重新錄製過，因為他們的網站已經有很大的變動。

cues.en: So in the future it might be possible that they've done some other design changes.
cues.zh: 未來也可能再改版。

cues.en: The website might look slightly different from this, but it doesn't matter.
cues.zh: 網站看起來可能稍微不同，但沒關係。

cues.en: You'll be able to find your way around.
cues.zh: 你還是能找到需要的地方。

cues.en: Okay, so what you want to do is go up here to products and then click on Individual Edition.
cues.zh: 先到上方的 Products，再點 Individual Edition。

cues.en: And that's going to bring you to this sub page.
cues.zh: 就會來到這個子頁面。

cues.en: And you can scroll down.
cues.zh: 接著往下捲，

cues.en: And then we want to go on download, which actually just brings us all the way down to the bottom of the page.
cues.zh: 點 Download，其實只是帶我們到頁面最下方。

cues.en: So here you see several options for Anaconda installer.
cues.zh: 這裡有幾種 Anaconda 安裝程式可選。

cues.en: So it's all the same program.
cues.zh: 都是同一套程式，

cues.en: But which version you need obviously depends on your operating system windows, Mac or Linux.
cues.zh: 但要選哪個版本，當然取決於作業系統是 Windows、Mac 還是 Linux。

cues.en: And it depends on whether you want Python three or Python two.
cues.zh: 另外也取決於你要 Python 3 還是 Python 2。

cues.en: Now let me say a super important warning.
cues.zh: 先說一個非常重要的提醒。

cues.en: You do not want to install Python two.
cues.zh: 不要安裝 Python 2。

cues.en: All right, so that said you pick your operating system Python three and then most likely you're going to be using the 64 bit version.
cues.zh: 選擇自己的作業系統，以及 Python 3；大多數情況應該會使用 64 位元版本。

cues.en: Although you know, it's maybe you have a really old computer or something and you're doing 32 bit, but I guess it's 64 bit.
cues.zh: 除非電腦很老之類的，才可能用 32 位元，不過我想大概都是 64 位元。

cues.en: So then it's very simple.
cues.zh: 接下來很簡單，

cues.en: You just click here.
cues.zh: 點這裡，

cues.en: This is going to start downloading the installer.
cues.zh: 就會開始下載安裝程式。

cues.en: Now I'm actually going to cancel this because I already have Anaconda installed here.
cues.zh: 我已經裝好 Anaconda，所以這裡取消下載。

cues.en: But once this executable finishes downloading the installation is super easy.
cues.zh: 執行檔下載完後，安裝非常容易，

cues.en: I don't need to go through it with you.
cues.zh: 不需要我帶你操作。

cues.en: All you have to do is open up the installer and then you click on yes and continue.
cues.zh: 只要開啟安裝程式，按 Yes、繼續，

cues.en: It's very simple.
cues.zh: 非常簡單。

cues.en: You don't need to register, you don't need to pay.
cues.zh: 不必註冊，也不用付費，

cues.en: You don't need to provide your email address or your phone number or you know, your grandmother's credit card information.
cues.zh: 不用提供電子郵件、電話，或你祖母的信用卡資料。

cues.en: You don't need any personal data.
cues.zh: 不需要任何個人資料。

cues.en: All you do is just keep clicking.
cues.zh: 只要一直按，

cues.en: Yes, and eventually it's going to install.
cues.zh: Yes，最後就會安裝完成。

cues.en: When the install finishes, you can then find Anaconda, for example in windows you can find it here.
cues.zh: 完成後就能找到 Anaconda。例如 Windows 裡，可以在這裡找。

cues.en: So it's going to be in where is it Anaconda here.
cues.zh: 它會在這裡，Anaconda，在哪裡呢？這裡。

cues.en: Or you can also type you can start typing it in Anaconda and you'll probably see a few icons.
cues.zh: 也可以開始輸入 Anaconda，通常會出現幾個圖示。

cues.en: But the one you want to look for is called Anaconda Navigator.
cues.zh: 其中要找的是 Anaconda Navigator。

cues.en: You can look for this pretty nifty little green circle thing here.
cues.zh: 找這個很可愛的綠色小圓圈。

cues.en: I'm not really sure exactly what that is, but this is the icon that you're looking for.
cues.zh: 我不太確定它到底代表什麼，但你要找的就是這個圖示。

cues.en: You want the the program called Anaconda Navigator.
cues.zh: 程式名稱是 Anaconda Navigator。

cues.en: So we click on that.
cues.zh: 點開它。

cues.en: Of course you can also make a link to your desktop or wherever you prefer to start your programs from.
cues.zh: 當然，也能在桌面，或你慣用的啟動位置，建立捷徑。

cues.en: You will initially get to this screen here this window Anaconda Navigator.
cues.zh: 一開始會看到這個畫面，也就是 Anaconda Navigator 視窗。

cues.en: So Anaconda basically provides a bunch of different platforms for you to use Python or R or other languages.
cues.zh: 基本上，Anaconda 提供多種平台，讓你使用 Python、R 或其他語言。

cues.en: And there's different ways of using Anaconda.
cues.zh: 使用 Anaconda 的方式很多。

cues.en: Navigator is actually quite a lot that you can do with this.
cues.zh: Navigator 能做的事其實相當多。

cues.en: That said, you don't need to worry about any fancy things.
cues.zh: 不過，不用管那些複雜功能，

cues.en: You don't need to worry about changing any settings.
cues.zh: 也不用調整任何設定。

cues.en: It's very simple.
cues.zh: 做法很簡單，

cues.en: You just look for this Jupyter notebook option here and then you click on launch.
cues.zh: 找到這裡的 Jupyter Notebook，按 Launch 即可。

cues.en: That will open up a new tab in your web browser.
cues.zh: 它會在網頁瀏覽器裡開啟新分頁。

cues.en: So notice that the Jupyter IPython notebook is going to run inside whatever is your web browser of choice.
cues.zh: 注意，Jupyter IPython Notebook 會在你選用的瀏覽器內執行。

cues.en: Now when you first open it, it's going to show you the folders and files that you have on your computer.
cues.zh: 第一次開啟時，會顯示電腦上的資料夾和檔案。

cues.en: So what you want to do is click through here and basically find where you have downloaded the files for this course.
cues.zh: 接著點進資料夾，找到你下載這門課檔案的位置。

cues.en: The first lecture of every section in this course contains a zip file that you download, and that contains a bunch of files.
cues.zh: 每一章第一堂都有可下載的 ZIP，裡面包含多個檔案。

cues.en: And mostly what you're looking for is this Python notebook file.
cues.zh: 主要要找的是 Python Notebook 檔案。

cues.en: So this is going to be called something whatever is the section of the course.
cues.zh: 檔名會依課程章節命名，

cues.en: And then ipynb for IPython notebook.
cues.zh: 副檔名是 .ipynb，代表 IPython Notebook。

cues.en: Now you click on that file that's going to open up a new tab over here.
cues.zh: 點這個檔案，就會在這裡開啟新分頁。

cues.en: And this is the file that contains all of the code that corresponds to the code that I go through in the video.
cues.zh: 這份檔案包含影片中示範的所有程式碼。

cues.en: Now I have discussed in the previous video on how to get the most out of this course, how to succeed in this course that I actually don't recommend just going through.
cues.zh: 上一段關於如何獲得最大收穫、如何學好這門課的影片，我說過不建議只是一路，

cues.en: And, you know, just kind of running this code, each cell at a time without really thinking about it that much.
cues.zh: 執行這些程式碼，一次執行一個儲存格，卻沒有多加思考。

cues.en: Of course, I recommend writing code in a fresh notebook as you follow along with me.
cues.zh: 我當然比較建議你開一份新的 Notebook，跟著我自己寫程式。

cues.en: So to get a fresh notebook, you can go over here.
cues.zh: 要建立新的 Notebook，可以到這裡，

cues.en: Click on New Python three notebook.
cues.zh: 點 New，再選 Python 3 Notebook。

cues.en: Again, make sure you click on Python three in case you have older versions of Python also installed.
cues.zh: 如果也裝了舊版 Python，再次提醒，一定要選 Python 3。

cues.en: So a new Python three notebook.
cues.zh: 就是新的 Python 3 Notebook。

cues.en: And that's going to open up a fresh notebook for you.
cues.zh: 這樣就會開啟一份全新的 Notebook。

cues.en: So I'm going to you can click on untitled one here and rename this to, you know, my favorite notebook.
cues.zh: 可以點這裡的 Untitled1，把它改名，例如 my favorite notebook。

cues.en: Okay, maybe that's not such a great name, but you know, you get the idea.
cues.zh: 好，這個名字也許不太好，但你知道我的意思。

cues.en: So in this video, I showed you how to download and install the Anaconda package, which will allow you to use the Jupyter IPython notebook to follow along with this course.
cues.zh: 這段影片示範了如何下載、安裝 Anaconda，透過 Jupyter IPython Notebook 跟著上課。

cues.en: This is the way that I recommend following along.
cues.zh: 這就是我建議的跟課方式。

cues.en: I think it's the easiest and most convenient way to participate in this course.
cues.zh: 我認為這是參與這門課最簡單、最方便的方式。

cues.en: That said, if you prefer not to do a local installation or if you're unable to do a local installation, then stay tuned.
cues.zh: 不過，如果你不想在本機安裝，或無法安裝，請繼續看。

cues.en: In the next video, I'm going to show you how to do everything online without any local installations.
cues.zh: 下一段影片會示範完全在線上操作、不用在本機安裝的方式。
